fieldFixes.summary: On 8 April 2026 IEEE SA approved an Industry Connections activity, 'Individual Defined Privacy Terms Roadmap' (ICAID IC26-005-01; its page went up the same day). The activity is to help Customer Commons, MyData Global and the MyTerms Alliance move IEEE 7012 from standard to real-world adoption by piloting training, developing road maps, identifying certification programmes and writing an industry white paper. Justin Byrd chairs it and Kari McMullen is vice chair. myterms.info announced its kick-off for 1 June 2026.
fieldFixes.significance: Aims to move the standard from text to adoption through training, road maps and certification, the adoption step that P3P and Do Not Track never completed. The MyTerms Alliance separately plans a trust mark.

issues: All 3 sources re-fetched 2026-09-23 and --check FOUND, as is the record quote. myterms.info/agreements/ carries the same text.

The plainSummary goes beyond the sources in two places. (1) 'It is the agreement a person's agent proposes first': the sources say it is the 'base/ default' agreement for anyone proposing MyTerms (MyData: 'The default agreement...'). Nothing says it is proposed first, and the FAQ describes choosing SD-BASE and offering alternates. (2) 'no tracking beyond the service': the MyTerms FAQ's own gloss is a shop's tacit deal, where the site will 'provide their services and nothing else, and may observe you while you are there, and not share information about you to other parties'. So first-party observation is allowed and only sharing with others is ruled out. Rewritten to match, with the FAQ added as a source.

Caution for the editorial layer (no field change): the five agreements are Customer Commons / MyTerms Alliance launch-phase texts, not normative content of IEEE 7012. The FAQ says 'The names are chosen by Customer Commons'. Searls says the agreement is 'one of a short list posted at the website of a neutral nonprofit'. ProjectVRM calls them 'five draft agreements'. The FAQ says 5 at launch and '8 more in the pipeline'.

fieldFixes.plainSummary: The default: the site or service provides what the person came for and nothing else. Like the tacit deal in a shop, it may observe the person while they are there but does not share information about them with other parties. It is the base/default agreement for anyone whose agent proposes MyTerms to an organisation.
